description:
Bind an EXISTING server you already control to your account. THIS IS THE UNIVERSAL PATH:
    it works on ANY provider - any hosting VPS or your own bare-metal, anything with a public IP
    running Ubuntu/Debian. If the user already HAS a server, Zoxron deploys onto it no matter who
    hosts it; provider brand is irrelevant here. DO NOT name or list specific VPS providers to the
    user - just ask what they use if you need to. (Only the OPTIONAL 'create me a server from
    scratch' path - cloud_provision - can automate some providers directly; when it can't, this
    path covers the rest. Never imply the whole product is limited; when a user has any server, lead
    with THIS.) Returns a one-time token
    and the exact command to run ON that server (needs root there); then call host_enroll_confirm with
    the same host. This proves control: only someone with root on the box can place the token, so
    nobody who merely knows its address can enroll your server. Use this before any provisioning on a
    server Zoxron did not create for you.
name: host_enroll
